symbolic.design_contract: Rank-0 scatter/select/gather rejects any axis. ND can produce scalar output from rank>=1 data.
symbolic.name: rank_zero_axis

symbolic.design_contract: Rank 8 uses singleton padding. Rank 9 rejects before dispatch.
symbolic.name: rank_limit

symbolic.design_contract: N=2^31-1 remains symbolic. N=2^31 rejects. No large allocation.
symbolic.name: count_limit

actual_ir_required: Actual generated IR must show unsigned U32->U64 extension, or a demonstrably equivalent 64-bit zero extension.
A signed offset consumer receives I64 with upper 32 bits zero for high-U32 physical offsets.
No signed I32 extension occurs on physical offsets >=0x80000000.
Word-offset to byte-address scaling uses 64-bit arithmetic and preserves the positive offsets in the fixtures.
The masked-coordinate selection dominates doubling, high-word addition, zero extension, pointer construction, and memory use.
Both low and high pointer construction sites satisfy these checks for values and destination; a host extent receipt is insufficient.
attachments.label: wide_pointer_pairs

symbolic.design_contract: Checked U32 pair arithmetic, unsigned U32->U64 extension before signed I64 TilePtr offset, actual IR acceptance, and masked-lane sanitation.
symbolic.name: wide_physical_extent

symbolic.design_contract: Signed values <0 reject. Index payloads do not inherit negative dimension wrapping.
symbolic.name: signed_index_low

symbolic.design_contract: I64/U64 2^32+1 cannot become coordinate 1 after narrowing.
symbolic.name: wide_index_alias

symbolic.design_contract: For axis length L, L-1 is valid and L is invalid. L=0 permits no update.
symbolic.name: upper_coordinate

symbolic.design_contract: Do not cast i32::MAX or L into I8/U8 before comparison.
symbolic.name: narrow_bound_scalar

symbolic.design_contract: Tuple [1,-1] rejects before linearization and cannot alias a preceding row.
symbolic.name: ND_coordinate_validation

symbolic.design_contract: Checked shape products and per-axis bounds precede I32 linearization.
symbolic.name: ND_linear_overflow

symbolic.design_contract: Empty scatter/select updates preserve destination after dtype/shape validation. Nonempty updates to L=0 reject.
symbolic.name: empty_axis_updates

symbolic.design_contract: M=0, K=0 or zero index elements reject under pinned public checks and Native nd_shape.
symbolic.name: ND_empty_indices

attachments.label: ND_zero_trailing_slice
attachments.qualification: Reference of selected current empty-payload shortcut; this is not an observed backend result.

symbolic.design_contract: Nonempty valid index shape with zero trailing slice yields empty payload. Current Native skips coordinate reads.
symbolic.name: empty_ND_trailing_slice

attachments.label: valid-reversed-index-view
attachments.reason: same physical extent, valid reversed view

attachments.label: non-dense-output
attachments.reason: in-bounds output span but non-dense strides

symbolic.design_contract: i32::MIN/MAX strides are symbolic. Use I128 host span arithmetic and reject any nonempty out-of-storage span.
symbolic.name: signed_view_span

attachments.label: stale_whole_word_CAS_counterexample
attachments.scope: CAS feasibility reference only; selected baseline is exclusive word ownership.

symbolic.design_contract: Odd half offset and final half share words. Unselected fields and unused tail bits remain unchanged.
symbolic.name: packed_neighbor

attachments.label: missing-destination-high-word
attachments.reason: eight-word extent needs final high word

attachments.label: missing-value-high-word
attachments.reason: six-word values extent needs final high word

symbolic.design_contract: I64/U64/F64 high and low words belong to one logical owner. No independent-word atomic arithmetic.
symbolic.name: wide_word_pair

symbolic.design_contract: Max([-8,-7],base=-9)=-7. Zero is an invalid identity for this fold.
symbolic.name: all_negative_extrema

symbolic.design_contract: Empty contribution set returns the base. Min/Max do not initialize destinations to zero or infinity.
symbolic.name: base_inclusion

symbolic.design_contract: Equal finite values stay equal. Min(+0,-0), Max(+0,-0), Add(-0,-0), and Mul(-0,+1) require bit checks.
symbolic.name: float_ties_and_zeros

symbolic.design_contract: Exercise NaN on either side, both NaN, and NaN followed by finite. Payload policy and Linux lowering remain open.
symbolic.name: NaN_classes

symbolic.design_contract: Inf+(-Inf), 0*Inf, overflow, smallest subnormal, and half RNE midpoints need explicit arithmetic policy.
symbolic.name: infinity_and_underflow

symbolic.design_contract: [2^(p),1,-2^(p)] distinguishes per-update storage rounding from one final rounding. No invented tolerance.
symbolic.name: nonassociative_duplicates

attachments.label: inclusive_unique_gradient_tie
attachments.rule: Both inclusive comparisons receive full upstream; duplicate gradients excluded. Exact central differences do not define this chosen tie subgradient.

attachments.label: inclusive_unique_gradient_tie
attachments.rule: Both inclusive comparisons receive full upstream; duplicate gradients excluded. Exact central differences do not define this chosen tie subgradient.

symbolic.design_contract: Pinned unique-index Min/Max backward sends full gradient to both equal inputs. Duplicate gradients remain undefined.
symbolic.name: minmax_gradient_tie

actual physical ownership and tail preservation
attachments.label: semantic_failure_then_valid_reference

symbolic.design_contract: One semantic failure must not poison a later independent valid graph. Retired temporaries live through queued completion.
symbolic.name: error_and_lifetime
